description: Monthly cost of living for one person, in EUR, estimated from each country's price level: the Netherlands' figures (see cost-of-living.json) × the country's price level ratio next to the Netherlands' for costs without housing, and × that ratio squared for rent. Rounded to the nearest 10. Rough estimates: countries differ from the Netherlands in more than their price level.

source.priceLevel: World Bank, World Development Indicators PA.NUS.PPPC.RF: price level ratio of the PPP conversion factor (GDP) to the market exchange rate. International Comparison Program 2021 benchmark, extrapolated by the World Bank to later years. CC BY 4.0.
source.inflation: World Bank, World Development Indicators FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG: inflation, consumer prices (annual %). CC BY 4.0.
